body.heading: Letter by letter
paragraphs: Start at A. Ant! B. Bear! C. Cat! Say an animal for each letter as far as you can go.
Some letters are easy and some are tricky. Q and X might need a grown-up clue.

body.heading: Draw the tricky ones
paragraphs: Pick the animal that was hardest to think of and draw it on your page.
Write its letter beside it in your biggest, proudest writing.

takeaway: The alphabet is full of animals, from ant to zebra.
safetyNotes: It is fine to peek at a picture book together for the hardest letters.
screenFreeExtension: Turn your alphabet into a poster for your wall.
